items.title: Realtor app - 'Refer Mortgage' banner and today's inspection cards
items.description: A hand-held phone over a laptop showing a Nigerian real-estate agent app. A 'Refer Mortgage' banner sits above a 'Today' row of two inspection cards - Folasade Adeyemi '4 Bed Semi-Detached - Financing: Cash purchase' and Bunmi Ogun '4 Bed Terrace', each with an agent portrait and 'Open the inspection'. A 'Clients' section begins below. The photo-on-desk staging sells the agent workflow.

items.title: Realtor app - agent profile page with stats and WhatsApp CTA
items.description: The same realtor app's 'Your page': a blue header with an agent portrait, 'Ngozi Okonkwo / Guapple, Abuja', social icons, and a stats strip (12 deals closed, 40% conversion, 30 investors). An 'About me' card ('I help buyers and sellers navigate the local market...') precedes a black 'Whatsapp' button and a 'Properties' shelf. The profile turns an agent into a trust page with one tap to chat.

items.title: Veeza AI - visa application pitched on a laptop with a skeleton phone
items.description: A product shot for 'Veeza AI': a laptop shows the blue site 'APPLY FOR YOUR VISA FASTER AND EASIER WITH AI' while a hand holds a phone displaying a grey skeleton/empty state of the app. The contrast - bold claim on the big screen, blank slate in the hand - frames the app as the starting point of a visa journey.

items.title: Event ticketing - tier counts, total sales and a sold-out nudge
items.description: An 'Event details' dashboard: ticket tiers stacked as big number pairs - 02/50 VIP, 12/100 Premium, 50/50 Regular - above 'Real time tickets sale'. A '$459,909,678,878 Total sales' figure with a rising line chart (Nov-Mar) leads, then tiles '₦5,500 Average ticket price' and '12 Tickets sold'. A nudge card asks 'Your tickets are almost sold out. Want to add more? Add tickets'. Currency in naira; a live ticket-sales view.

items.title: Text editor - empty 'Untitled-1.txt' with a find bar
items.description: The 'Text' Android editor in an empty state: 'Untitled-1.txt' tab, 'Start typing...' canvas, a left icon rail and a bottom 'Find' input above the 'Draft / INS Ln1 Col1 / View' status bar. Android Authority watermark. The same product as IMG-0357/0358/0360; the empty canvas is the whole screen.

items.title: Text editor - 'Welcome to Text' first-run dialog
items.description: The 'Text' editor's first-run dialog: 'Welcome to Text - View, create, and edit text files. Your progress saves automatically.' with 'By using Text, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy' and a green 'Get started' button, over a dimmed 'Untitled-1.txt' canvas. A clean onboarding gate for the editor family.

items.title: Text editor settings - theme segmented control and font-size slider
items.description: The 'Text' editor's Settings: a Display segmented control (Light / Dark / System, System selected in green), App section with an 'Auto save' toggle and a 'Font size: 14sp' slider, and About / Licenses rows. The green accent and watermark tie it to the editor family. A compact, conventional settings sheet.

items.title: Pomodoro - 'New topic' sheet with name, colour and shape pickers
items.description: A pink 'New topic' sheet over a 'Topics' header: Name field 'Gym', Color row (Dynamic / Red selected plus pastel swatches), and a Shape grid of outlined geometry (circle, squircle, triangle, hexagon, star...) with one dark-red shape selected. Cancel / Next close it. The topic gets a name, a colour and a glyph - identity for a timer.

items.title: Pomodoro - Gym topic with 25/5/15 and session settings
items.description: The pink Pomodoro topic screen for 'Gym': three big figures Focus 25 / Short break 5 / Long break 15, a 'Session length' slider ('Focus intervals in one session: 4'), and toggles 'Auto start next timer' and 'Do Not Disturb'. Back / 'Add topic' buttons close it. The 25/5/15 trio states the whole method at a glance.

items.title: Property browse - search, type chips and listing cards
items.description: A US property-search home: 'Current Address 70 Washington Square South, NY', a 'Find your dream property' search, chips (All, House, Apartment, Penthouse), then listing cards - 'Loft Queens Boulevard / For sell / 3 Beds 2 Baths 2000 Sqft / New York, USA / $289,000' with a photo, and an 'Apartment' card. A floating pill nav marks Home. A conventional, photo-first browse layout.

items.title: Multi-currency banking home - USD + naira balances and transactions
items.description: A light banking home greeting 'Welcome back Iyanu Daniel' with a flag trio (US/UK/Nigeria) and 'Total Balance $1,890,901.70'. Round actions Send / Receive / Convert / More sit above 'Balances' cards (US Dollars $90,901.70, Nigerian Naira ₦1,856,00.70) and a 'Transactions' list (Tory Middleton +$2,500, James Powell +$1,800, both Successful). Bottom nav: Home, Cards, Invest, Accounts. A multi-currency wallet presented as a bank.

items.title: Shared Categories pitch - errands list with owner/editor roles
items.description: A feature pitch headed by a red people icon and 'Shared Categories - You can now create shared categories so you and more people can add all types of items in a shared space.' A 'Share category' card shows 'Errands' with copy about everyone seeing changes, a PEOPLE list (Foldy Owner, Acu Can edit) and 'Errands Shared by Foldy', closing on 'Inbox 2'. Roles (owner/can edit) make the sharing model legible.
